title: Certificate expiry report
pitch: Review certificate renewal deadlines, named owners and practical next actions in one concise report.
makeItYours: Replace the fixed certificate list with inventory records and calculate days remaining before rendering.
Set your urgent and warning thresholds, keeping the same policy in the summary and table.
Assign renewal owners and a concrete next action for each certificate.
useCase: Use it when certificate renewals need an owner and a visible deadline.
